subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt timestamped config backup filenames now, and if so must the migration preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery files before merge?
rationale: This changes a core config recovery artifact and the linked canonical issue already flags legacy backup handling as a migration decision, so automation should not choose data-retention semantics alone.

options.title: Preserve Legacy Recovery Points
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep or convert existing numbered backups, harden their permissions, and prove the upgrade path before merge.

options.title: Accept Timestamp-Only Cleanup
options.body: Allow first-run cleanup to prune existing numbered backups in exchange for a clean timestamp-only scheme, with explicit maintainer approval and release notes.

options.title: Keep Numeric Ring For Now
options.body: Reject or pause the suffix change and keep the existing numbered backup ring until the broader backup-layout direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve Legacy Recovery Points
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep or convert existing numbered backups, harden their permissions, and prove the upgrade path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest visible config backup and recovery review history and merged the adjacent hardening work this PR must preserve.
